text:
anya: kicking off a config-only change now — routing weight tweaks + batching param adjust. change window 10:00-11:00 PT, soft rollout.

deploy-bot: queued config-only deploy cfg-2026-03-20-rw-batch by @anya -> prod. Mode=soft-canary. Canary targets: 4 pods in us-west-2. Auto-rollback: errors>3% OR p50>+100ms sustained 5m.

marco: quick q — are we also pinning model variant for enterprise traffic? last time mixing variants caused KV cache churn.

anya: not globally. plan was route override for enterprise only (pin to v3-small). keeping general traffic on v3-medium.

lia: +1 on enterprise_pin. also recommend lowering max_batch_size to 6 for latency-sensitive routes.

jonas: telemetry from preflight looked ok, but keep an eye on KV cache hit rate and memory pressure.

deploy-bot: canary started: cfg-2026-03-20-rw-batch -> 4 pods (us-west-2). Metrics dashboard: https://obs.redwood/chaos/cfg-2026-03-20-rw-batch

marco: i added a tiny tweak to JSON:
```json
{
  "routing_overrides": {"enterprise": {"model_pin": "v3-small"}},
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 6, "batch_timeout_ms": 12}
}
```

anya: holding on the enterprise pin roll until canary stable for 20m. watching errors + p50.

ops-bot: alert: canary error rate up to 2.1% (5m window). tagging @eng-oncall :warning:

eng-oncall: investigating — seeing an uptick in request timeouts and kvcache evictions on canary pods. correlating with reduced batch size.

jonas: hmm, smaller batches increased per-token concurrency, appears to push kvcache memory churn. suggested quick rollback of batching change only.

anya: go for rollback of batching tweak, keep routing override paused. execute now.

deploy-bot: action: rollback config fragment batching -> reverted to previous values (max_batch_size=8, batch_timeout_ms=15) on canary. Rollback time 10:18 PT. Canary re-evaluating.

deploy-bot: canary stable after rollback. error rate back to baseline 0.3%, p50 within expected.

marco: noted — we'll keep enterprise pin queued but gated behind kvcache fix. adding ticket: INF-4827 to track pin + cache improvements.

anya: will update release notes: called out enterprise pin deferred, batching revert, condition that will unblock. will schedule follow-up change window after INF-4827.

lia: thanks all. TL;DR: config-only deploy attempted, batching tweak rolled back due to kvcache pressure, enterprise model pin paused.

anya: filing post-deploy checklist now and closing rollout. :white_check_mark:
